name: iwdg_windowmode
description: IWDG_WindowMode: the IWDG at LSI / 16 with a reload of 1561 (780 ms) and a window of 800, refreshed every 450 ms, after the window opens, while LD2 toggles; B1's callback shortens the wait to 200 ms, so the next refresh comes while the counter is still above the window and the IWDG resets the part (IWDG_WINR), which then holds LD2 on for 4 s (RCC_CSR's IWDGRSTF).
